payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the model Jasper on various datasets, including WER percentages.

claims.text: Jasper achieved a state-of-the-art (SOTA) result of 2.95% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external language model.
Jasper also reported a WER of 3.86% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a greedy decoder without a language model.
The model showed competitive results on the Wall Street Journal and the Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
Jasper achieved competitive results on the 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard dataset.
